queries.sql: SELECT `i`.`path` as `image`, `ig`.`path` as `image_groupe`, `il`.`path` as `logoffessm`, `g`.`nomClub`, `g`.`description`, `g`.`philosophie`, `g`.`nombreNageurs`, `g`.`projetSportif`, `g`.`lienFacebook`, `g`.`lienInstagram`, `g`.`lienffessm`, `g`.`lienDrive`, ROUND(g.nombreHommes / g.nombreNageurs * 100, 1) as pourcentH, ROUND((g.nombreNageurs - g.nombreHommes) / g.nombreNageurs * 100, 1) as pourcentF FROM `general` `g` LEFT JOIN `images` `i` ON `g`.`image_id` = `i`.`id` LEFT JOIN `images` `ig` ON `g`.`image_groupe_id` = `ig`.`id` LEFT JOIN `images` `il` ON `g`.`logoffessm_id` = `il`.`id`
